findings: Atrebates already has a Roman Ally, so Build there does not require Supply under §4.2.1. Card12 unshaded removes the Leader-proximity requirement.

The post-Build six-piece Recruit is legal in the original all-NP state, but NP Belgae refuse Supply (§8.4.2), so Atrebates Recruit costs two Resources (§3.2.1). The original parent execution incorrectly omitted that cost.
The original all-domain equality proof therefore did not establish complete rules validity. The Build-before-Recruit threshold omission remains independently supported by §8.8.4.
An explicitly identified human-consent variant preserves the original physical and Resource outcome; it changes seat ownership and is not relabeled as the archived all-NP game.

Later consent review corrects the cost claim: NP Belgae refuse Supply at Atrebates, so its Recruit costs two Resources; the prior parent execution omitted that cost.
